caseName: Municipal Court of the Southeast Judicial District v. Gutierrez
caseNameFull: Municipal Court of the Southeast Judicial District, County of Los Angeles v. Gutierrez

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of U. S. English Foundation, Inc., et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded to the Court of Appeals with instructions to dismiss the appeal as moot. United States v. Munsingwear, Inc., 340 U. S. 36 (1950).
